name: rockgame
description: The stone-skipping game. App shell plus the feature labs: rock-forge, rock-sift, babylon-water, stone-skipping-physics, sand-sim — each living in its own page.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hub,sift,forge,sand -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "vite" "npm --prefix rock-sift run dev" "npm --prefix rock-forge run dev" "npm --prefix sand-sim run dev"
scripts.deploy: node tools/build-site.mjs && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name rockgame
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix rock-sift install && npm --prefix rock-forge install && npm --prefix sand-sim install
scripts.test: node tools/store-test.mjs && node tools/loader-test.mjs && node tools/backend-contract-test.mjs && node tools/schema-check.mjs
